data.source: Native primary fixture, shown as a current, retained, eligible plan before execution.

constraints: First slice presents the controller-selected restore target; alternate snapshot selection requires the extended server contract.
Reviewing or selecting a retained snapshot does not execute rollback.
Execution must bind current release UID, snapshot UID/hash, target/configuration and plan version.
Do not imply a new Release is necessarily created, Kubernetes changes are atomic, or migrations/external effects are reversed.
Keep Current release and Restore snapshot labels explicit throughout.
clarification: The image-change fixture binds the digest aliases 8ac4…91bf → 45b2…d120. A version tag shown in an earlier illustration is not a substitute for immutable target binding.
